justification: Layout-only: the satellite checkbox on the brief landing hero moves ABOVE the 'Free instant check' helper text (it read as fine print below it) and gets a card-style pill treatment so it is visible as part of the search input. No data-path or behaviour change.

break_it.scenario: Products without searchExtras (flood, shadow, conveyancing landings) render the hero
break_it.what_happens: searchExtras is undefined so nothing renders between the search bar and the helper text - identical layout to before
break_it.how: the slot renders the prop verbatim; undefined renders nothing in JSX
break_it.repro: open /reports/flood while idle - hero unchanged; npx jest passes 713 tests

post_merge.manual_verify: open /reports/intelligence-brief while idle: checkbox pill sits directly under the search bar, above the 'Free instant check' line; ticking it and running from the hero sends include_satellite true
